bio: Malmaison Leeds is housed within a stunning Victorian building, which was once the former Leeds City Tramways Office, just 5 minutes from Leeds railway station, in the heart of the city centre.  Malmaison have re-imagined the classic Afternoon Tea menu. Savouries include a beef slider on brioche bun, Cumberland sausage & apple roll and prawn cocktail. Sweet treats include Calamansi citrus meringue tart, dark chocolate & salted caramel tart and raspberry ripple & white chocolate sundae.  Special dietary requirements are catered for, with alternative menus for vegetarians/vegans and for those with gluten and nut allergies. Pre-booking is required. Please specify dietary needs using the 'Special Request' field.  All Afternoon Tea menus are served with a choice of teas and infusions, including English breakfast, Earl Grey and Green tea with jasmine.  Afternoon Tea is served Monday to Friday from 12pm to 4pm, Saturday and Sunday 12.30pm to 4pm, and costs £29.50 per person.
